ai.seo_question: What are the key spiritual attributes of Prophet Yahya mentioned in Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the unique divine bestowal of 'Hanin' (deep, innate compassion) and 'Zakat' (spiritual purity/growth) upon Yahya, underscoring his status as a child-prodigy of piety. The term 'Taqi' (pious) is often interpreted not merely as general righteousness but as a specific, elevated state of God-consciousness granted by Allah, distinguishing him among the prophets. This verse is frequently cited to illustrate the concept of 'Ilm al-Ladunni' (divine knowledge) and spiritual maturity bestowed upon the Imams and prophets from youth.
